# Сценарий сверки: битовые операции (SETBIT/GETBIT/BITCOUNT/BITPOS/BITOP/BITFIELD).
# Двоичные значения собираются через SETBIT — сценарий остаётся текстовым.

# --- SETBIT и GETBIT ---
SETBIT bm 0 1
SETBIT bm 2 1
SETBIT bm 9 1
GETBIT bm 0
GETBIT bm 1
GETBIT bm 2
GETBIT bm 9
GETBIT bm 100
GETBIT nosuch 0
STRLEN bm
SETBIT bm 0 0
GETBIT bm 0
SETBIT bm 2 1
SETBIT far 100000 1
STRLEN far
BITCOUNT far
GETBIT far 99999

# --- ошибки SETBIT/GETBIT ---
SETBIT bm 0 2
SETBIT bm -1 1
SETBIT bm 0 01
SETBIT bm 0 -0
GETBIT bm -1
GETBIT bm abc
RPUSH lst x
SETBIT lst 0 1
GETBIT lst 0

# --- BITCOUNT ---
SET k foobar
BITCOUNT k
BITCOUNT k 0 -1
BITCOUNT k 1 1
BITCOUNT k 1 -1
BITCOUNT k -5 -2
BITCOUNT k 3 1
BITCOUNT k 5 100
BITCOUNT k -100 200
BITCOUNT k 8 15 BIT
BITCOUNT k 10 13 bit
BITCOUNT k 0 47 BIT
BITCOUNT k 6 9 BIT
BITCOUNT nosuch
BITCOUNT k 0
BITCOUNT k 0 1 NIBBLE
BITCOUNT k a 1
BITCOUNT lst

# --- BITPOS: \xff\xf0 ---
SETBIT f2 0 1
SETBIT f2 1 1
SETBIT f2 2 1
SETBIT f2 3 1
SETBIT f2 4 1
SETBIT f2 5 1
SETBIT f2 6 1
SETBIT f2 7 1
SETBIT f2 8 1
SETBIT f2 9 1
SETBIT f2 10 1
SETBIT f2 11 1
BITPOS f2 1
BITPOS f2 0
BITPOS f2 0 0 -1
BITPOS f2 1 2 -1
BITPOS f2 0 2 2 BYTE

# --- BITPOS: все единицы (\xff\xff) ---
SETBIT oo 0 1
SETBIT oo 1 1
SETBIT oo 2 1
SETBIT oo 3 1
SETBIT oo 4 1
SETBIT oo 5 1
SETBIT oo 6 1
SETBIT oo 7 1
SETBIT oo 8 1
SETBIT oo 9 1
SETBIT oo 10 1
SETBIT oo 11 1
SETBIT oo 12 1
SETBIT oo 13 1
SETBIT oo 14 1
SETBIT oo 15 1
BITPOS oo 0
BITPOS oo 0 0 1
BITPOS oo 0 1
BITPOS oo 1
BITPOS oo 1 8 15 BIT

# --- BITPOS: \x00\xff\xf0 ---
SETBIT mx 8 1
SETBIT mx 9 1
SETBIT mx 10 1
SETBIT mx 11 1
SETBIT mx 12 1
SETBIT mx 13 1
SETBIT mx 14 1
SETBIT mx 15 1
SETBIT mx 16 1
SETBIT mx 17 1
SETBIT mx 18 1
SETBIT mx 19 1
BITPOS mx 1
BITPOS mx 0
BITPOS mx 1 0 0 BYTE
BITPOS mx 0 0 0 BYTE
BITPOS mx 1 2 -1 BIT
BITPOS mx 0 3 7 BIT
BITPOS mx 1 20 23 BIT
BITPOS mx 0 20 23 BIT

# --- BITPOS: отсутствующий и пустой ключи ---
BITPOS nosuch 0
BITPOS nosuch 1
BITPOS nosuch 0 5 3
SET empty ""
BITPOS empty 0
BITPOS empty 1
BITPOS empty 1 0 5 BIT
BITPOS lst 0
BITPOS f2 5
BITPOS f2 x
BITPOS f2 0 0 1 NIBBLE

# --- BITOP: AND/OR/XOR/NOT на foobar и abcdef ---
SET k1 foobar
SET k2 abcdef
BITOP AND d1 k1 k2
GET d1
BITOP OR d2 k1 k2
GET d2
BITOP XOR d3 k1 k2
GET d3
BITOP NOT d4 k1
GET d4
STRLEN d4
BITOP XOR d5 k1 nosuch
GET d5
BITOP AND d6 nosuch k1
GET d6
BITOP OR d7 nosuch alsonot
EXISTS d7
BITOP OR k1 k1 k2
GET k1
RPUSH lst2 y
BITOP NOT lst2 k1
TYPE lst2
SET ttlkey v
BITOP OR ttlkey k2 nosuch
TTL ttlkey

# --- BITOP: операции Redis 8.2 (X=10000100, A=11000000, B=01100000) ---
SETBIT X 0 1
SETBIT X 5 1
SETBIT A 0 1
SETBIT A 1 1
SETBIT B 1 1
SETBIT B 2 1
BITOP DIFF dx X A B
STRLEN dx
GETBIT dx 0
GETBIT dx 2
GETBIT dx 5
BITOP DIFF1 dd X A B
GETBIT dd 1
GETBIT dd 2
GETBIT dd 5
BITOP ANDOR da X A B
GETBIT da 0
GETBIT da 5
BITOP ONE dn A B
GETBIT dn 0
GETBIT dn 1
GETBIT dn 2
BITOP DIFF dd2 X A
GETBIT dd2 5
BITOP DIFF1 dd3 B X
GETBIT dd3 0
GETBIT dd3 5

# --- ошибки BITOP ---
BITOP NOT d a b
BITOP NOT d
BITOP DIFF d a
BITOP DIFF1 d a
BITOP ANDOR d a
BITOP NAND d a b
BITOP OR d
BITOP OR d lst k1

# --- BITFIELD ---
BITFIELD bits SET u4 0 3
BITFIELD bits GET u4 0
BITFIELD bits SET u4 0 15
BITFIELD bits INCRBY u4 0 1
BITFIELD bits INCRBY u4 0 1
BITFIELD bits GET u8 0
BITFIELD bits GET u4 #0
BITFIELD bits SET u4 #1 5
GET bits
BITFIELD satk OVERFLOW SAT INCRBY u4 0 15 INCRBY u4 0 1
BITFIELD failk SET u4 0 15 OVERFLOW FAIL INCRBY u4 0 1
BITFIELD failk GET u4 0
BITFIELD signed SET i8 0 -1 GET i8 0 GET u8 0
BITFIELD signed INCRBY i8 0 5 GET i8 0
BITFIELD wrap SET i8 0 127 INCRBY i8 0 1
BITFIELD wdown SET i4 0 0 INCRBY i4 0 -1
BITFIELD setwrap SET u4 0 300 GET u4 0
BITFIELD hash SET i8 #1 100 GET i8 #1 GET u8 #1
BITFIELD nosuch GET u8 0
BITFIELD nosuch GET u8 1000
BITFIELD bits
BITFIELD bits GET u8 1000
BITFIELD bits INCRBY u4 0 -1 INCRBY u4 0 -1
GET bits

# --- ошибки BITFIELD ---
BITFIELD bits SET u64 0 1
BITFIELD bits WHAT u8 0
BITFIELD bits OVERFLOW BOOM
BITFIELD bits GET u8
BITFIELD bits SET u8 0
BITFIELD bits INCRBY u8 0 x
BITFIELD bits SET q8 0 1
BITFIELD bits SET u8 -0 1
BITFIELD bits GET u8 #0
BITFIELD bits SET u4 I8 0 1
BITFIELD lst GET u8 0
BITFIELD lst SET u8 0 1

# --- BITFIELD_RO ---
BITFIELD_RO bits GET u4 #0
BITFIELD_RO nosuch GET u8 0
BITFIELD_RO bits SET u4 0 1
BITFIELD_RO bits SET q8 0 1
